name: Elena of Avalor
description: The story of a brave teenager who has saved her kingdom from an evil sorceress and must now learn to rule as a crown princess until she’s old enough to be queen.

videos.title: Adventures in Vallestrella: Flight of the Butterfrog
videos.overview: When a baby butterfrog is accidentally left behind, Isabel and the baby jaquins try to teach him to fly so he can catch up to his family.

videos.title: Adventures in Vallestrella: Human Nature
videos.overview: When a flaringo steals Isabel's spyglass, Elena, Isabel and the baby jaquins chase him down to get it back!

videos.title: Adventures in Vallestrella: Sleeping Sunbird
videos.overview: After accidentally releasing a mischievous duende from one of Quita Moz's jars, Elena and Isabel have to get it back inside before Quita Moz wakes up.

videos.title: Adventures in Vallestrella: Fast Food
videos.overview: When the baby jaquins find out that starfruit might be the reason that velociervos are so fast, they try to get their paws on some!

videos.title: Adventures in Vallestrella: Peabunny Boogie
videos.overview: While watching the peabunnies do their ritual friendship dance, Elena, Isabel and the baby jaquins help a footloose peabunny.

videos.title: Scepter Training with Zuzo: Royal Treasury Escape Room
videos.overview: In order to master her illuminate scepter power, Elena must get past booby-traps that Zuzo and Mateo set up in the Royal Treasury.

videos.title: Scepter Training with Zuzo: The Heist
videos.overview: Elena learns that with the scepter she can create illusions, this comes in pretty handy when a thief tries to steal something from the palace.

videos.title: Scepter Training with Zuzo: Nothing But Blaze
videos.overview: Mateo challenges Elena to a friendly battle of scepter versus tamborita.

videos.title: Scepter Training with Zuzo: Stowaway
videos.overview: While practicing her invisible scepter power with Zuzo, Elena must stop a masked bandit from stealing a ship.

videos.title: Scepter Training with Zuzo: Don't Be Our Guest
videos.overview: Elena uses her invisible scepter power to fend off a masked bandit who has snuck into the palace and stolen her locket.

videos.title: The Secret Life of Sirenas: Off to the Race
videos.overview: Cuco races a sea turtle to claim a prize piece of kelp.

videos.title: The Secret Life of Sirenas: Feeling Clammy
videos.overview: As Daria and Elena search for pearls, Ocho gets stuck in a giant clam.

videos.title: The Secret Life of Sirenas: Walk This Way
videos.overview: Elena helps Marzel practice walking on two legs.

videos.title: The Secret Life of Sirenas: Marisa and the Mirror
videos.overview: Marisa sees a mirror for the first time in her life.

videos.title: The Secret Life of Sirenas: One-Octopus Band
videos.overview: Ocho gets his tentacles on sunken treasure and finds his groove.

videos.title: Discovering the Magic Within: When the Royal Family's Away
videos.overview: When the Royal Family leaves the castle on a day trip, Flo has trouble staying out of trouble!

videos.title: Discovering the Magic Within: Spring Cleaning
videos.overview: Elena trains with Mateo and Quita Moz on how to use the crystal tamborita!

videos.title: Discovering the Magic Within: Not So Basic Training
videos.overview: Ready for a bigger challenge, Elena takes her crystal scepter training “to the streets” to help the good citizens of Avalor!

videos.title: Discovering the Magic Within: No Good Deed Goes Unpunished
videos.overview: Elena recruits her friends to help her master her new magic!

videos.title: Discovering the Magic Within: Modern Royal Family
videos.overview: The Royal Family and staff share confessional interviews about what it’s like living with Elena and her new magic!

videos.title: First Day of Rule
videos.overview: On the day Elena officially becomes Crown Princess, she must rescue her sister Isabel from aboard a missing ship.

videos.title: Model Sister
videos.overview: Elena is torn between a promise she made to help Isabel and fulfilling her royal duties as crown princess.

videos.title: All Heated Up
videos.overview: Elena finds herself at odds with the Grand Council when dealing with a magical rock whose anger can trigger a “monfuego” eruption.

videos.title: Island of Youth
videos.overview: While the castle is preparing a surprise party for Esteban, Elena and Mateo take him sailing to an island where the Fountain of Youth is located. Elena and Mateo must save Esteban when he drinks too much water and becomes younger.

videos.title: Spellbound
videos.overview: On the night Elena decides to appoint Mateo as Royal Wizard of Avalor, an evil malvago and old enemy of Alakazar named Fiero turns her family and the citizens to stone. Mateo must put his skills to the test to stop Fiero and save the people of Avalor

videos.title: Prince Too Charming
videos.overview: Elena visits the Kingdom of Cordoba to oversee construction of a bridge between it and Avalor but is convinced by lazy and spoiled Prince Alonso to shirk her royal duties. Elena must save the kingdom when the digging awakens a totem giant from Mayan folklore named the Yacalli.

videos.title: Finders Leapers
videos.overview: During an archeological dig, Esteban accidentally releases a mischievous duende, a magical elf-like creature based on Latino folklore, who sets out on a mission to unleash hundreds of other duendes on Avalor.

videos.title: Royal Retreat
videos.overview: Elena attends her first Royal Retreat as Crown Princess and learns that it is more important to do what is right than to fit in after a clashing disagreement with one of her fellow rulers.

videos.title: A Day to Remember
videos.overview: On Dia de los Muertos, Elena discovers her ability to see ghosts and sets out to help the spirit of a woman mend the rift between her grandchildren and save the family restaurant.

videos.title: The Scepter of Light
videos.overview: When a moth fairy tries to bring "the gift of eternal darkness" to Avalor during a solar eclipse, Elena must learn how to control the magic in her royal scepter.

videos.title: Elena and the Secret of Avalor
videos.overview: Elena laments how she was trapped in the magical Amulet of Avalor for forty-one years, until she was set free by a brave young Princess: Sofia The First.

videos.title: Navidad
videos.overview: Elena brings all the communities of Avalor together to share each other's holiday traditions. But when a Doña Paloma scheme causes an overly competitive atmosphere, Elena sets off on a traditional "parranda" and carols through the city to remind everyone of the true spirit of Navidad.

videos.title: Olaball
videos.overview: Elena helps coach Gabe when he joins Avalor's Royal "olaball" team despite being a terrible player.

videos.title: Flight of the Jaquins
videos.overview: Skylar is chosen to help train three young jaquins on defending the kingdom of Avalor.

videos.title: Crystal in the Rough
videos.overview: On Isabel’s first day of school, she tries changing herself in order to fit in on a field trip to the Crystal Caverns.

videos.title: The Princess Knight
videos.overview: Elena enters a fencing tournament disguised as "Knight Elezar" to prove that she is a great fencer.

videos.title: Captain Turner Returns
videos.overview: Naomi's mom gets a new job in their old kingdom. Naomi and Elena try to convince her not to move the family away from Avalor.

videos.title: King of the Carnaval
videos.overview: Esteban’s childhood friend, Victor, returns to Avalor during the kingdom’s Carnaval celebration and convinces Esteban to help him rob the royal treasury.

videos.title: My Fair Naomi
videos.overview: When Elena finds out that her best friend Naomi's sixteenth birthday is coming up, she decides to throw her a Royal Quinceanera at the palace! But when Naomi becomes obsessed with having the perfect party, their friendship is put to the test.

videos.title: Spirit Monkey Business
videos.overview: Elena must rescue Mateo when an unruly spirit monkey launches him into the Spirit World.

videos.title: Wizard-in-Training
videos.overview: Mateo takes on an apprentice, but soon discovers teaching is harder than it looks.

videos.title: Realm of the Jaquins
videos.overview: Elena travels to the realm of the jaquins, but unknowingly puts Avalor in danger.

videos.title: The Gecko's Tale
videos.overview: Elena and her sister Isabel must work together to help undo a curse when an explorer is turned into a gecko.

videos.title: Party of a Lifetime
videos.overview: Elena and her friends get stranded on a sailboat and are rescued by a mysterious ship.

videos.title: Blockheads
videos.overview: Elena and her friends are transformed into sculptures!

videos.title: Masks of Magic
videos.overview: Elena must work with Doña Paloma to break a spell.

videos.title: The Jewel of Maru
videos.overview: On Día de los Muertos, Elena meets a Maruvian ghost named Amaláy who stands watch over the powerful Jewel of Maru.

videos.title: Royal Rivalry
videos.overview: Elena invites a princess from a neighboring kingdom to Avalor hoping to repair an old alliance.

videos.title: The Curse of El Guapo
videos.overview: When Captain Sandoval retires, a skill competition is used to select his successor. Gabe is possessed by the spirit of a sword of a former General called El Guapo and acts like a jerk during the competition.

videos.title: Three Jaquins and a Princess
videos.overview: Isabel tries to prove that that she can handle more responsibility by looking after three baby jaquins by herself.

videos.title: A Spy in the Palace
videos.overview: While in disguise, Carla infiltrates the castle to try and steal Elena's mother's tiara.

videos.title: Science Unfair
videos.overview: Isabel enters the science fair with her friends but ignores Elena's advice about teamwork and tries to do everything herself.

videos.title: Rise of the Sorceress
videos.overview: Elena comes face-to-face with Shuriki in a magical battle and the evil wizard, Fiero, returns to join Shuriki on her quest to retake control over Avalor.

videos.title: Shapeshifters
videos.overview: Convinced that she must personally search for Shuriki, Elena shapeshifts into a jaquin but becomes framed for a crime she didn't commit.

videos.title: The Scepter of Night
videos.overview: After saving her kingdom from an evil sorceress, Princess Elena must prepare for her new role.

videos.title: The Race for the Realm
videos.overview: Elena races to Vallestrella to find the missing pieces of the Scepter of Night befor Shuriki can get her hands on them.

videos.title: A Tale of Two Scepters
videos.overview: Elena returns to Vallestrella to receive training from three mystical sun birds on how to master her Scepter of Light.

videos.title: Class Act
videos.overview: Isabel takes her first class at the Science Academy with her favorite scientist, Professor Ochoa.

videos.title: All Kingdoms Fair
videos.overview: When Armando's older brother Santos comes to Avalor, Armando loses all confidence in his ability to run the All Kingdoms Fair.

videos.title: A Lava Story
videos.overview: When a female rock creature is unhappy, Elena enlists the help of Charoca to find out why before she causes a monfuego to erupt.

videos.title: Song of the Sirenas
videos.overview: While visiting her cousin who lives along the coast of Avalor, Elena encounters a group of mermaid-like sea creatures called sirenas and learns about their complicated history with humans. In an attempt to make amends, Elena befriends the sirenas and enlists their help to defeat evil sorceress Shuriki.

videos.title: The Tides of Change
videos.overview: When Elena attempts to get a Unity Pact signed between the humans and the sirenas, Daria enlists the help of evil shape-shifting dolphins called malandros to disrupt the peace.

videos.title: The Return of El Capitán
videos.overview: On Día de los Muertos, Elena and her abuelo team up with the spirits of two of his old friends, El Guerrero and El Místico, to complete a mission that they had started many years ago and were not able to complete.

videos.title: Finding Zuzo
videos.overview: When Zuzo goes missing in the spirit world, Elena enlists the help of other spirit guides to find him.

videos.title: Snow Place Like Home
videos.overview: A snowstorm threatens to ruin Elena’s plans of spending a quiet and peaceful Navidad at home.

videos.title: Two Left Fins
videos.overview: After being invited to attend his first Royal Retreat, Prince Marzel tries hard to impress and accidentally turns the visiting kings into Sirenas.

videos.title: Movin' On Up
videos.overview: When Elena invites Mateo to move into his own Royal Wizard quarters within the palace, his mother assumes she is invited to move in too.

videos.title: Not Without My Magic
videos.overview: While her magical scepter isn't working properly, Elena is forced to face a fire starting creature without her magic.

videos.title: Luna's Big Leap
videos.overview: Luna convinces King Verago to give her a shot at joining the King's Guard and gets partnered with a gruff jaquin named Tornado to show her the ropes.

videos.title: Naomi Knows Best
videos.overview: When Victor, Carla and Ash capture Elena and her friends, Naomi must trust her instincts to save them.

videos.title: Sister of Invention
videos.overview: Isabel tries to prove she's old enough to join Elena and her team when they set off on a mission to track down escaped villains Ash and Carla.

videos.title: To Save a Sunbird
videos.overview: After Elena discovers that Hool used up her life force to repair her scepter, she risks everything to save her friend.

videos.title: Father-in-Chief
videos.overview: On the day the new Chief of the Jaquins will be chosen, Migs must bring his three Jaquin kids to work.

videos.title: The Incredible Shrinking Royals
videos.overview: Things go awry when newly-elected Magister of Trade, Julio, decides to host his first Feast of Friendship and ancient magic shrinks all of the royal attendees.

videos.title: Norberg Peace Prize
videos.overview: Elena takes a trip to the Kingdom of Norberg to help their Queen resolve a dispute with a neighboring kingdom.

videos.title: The Magic Within
videos.overview: On the eve of Carnaval, Elena attempts to capture Avalor's most dangerous villain and falls into an ancient well of magic crystals, giving her new magical abilities.

videos.title: Flower of Light
videos.overview: When two mischievous spirits try to ruin Dia de los Muertos, Elena teams up with her childhood friend Felicia to travel to the spirit world and save the holiday.

videos.title: Captain Mateo
videos.overview: Mateo and Gabe's friendship is put to the test after Mateo is put in charge of the Royal Guard.

videos.title: Sugar Rush
videos.overview: When Elena is having trouble making time for family, Luisa convinces her to reopen the family chocolate shop.

videos.title: The Family Treasure
videos.overview: Elena and Isabel help two feuding brothers find a valuable treasure hidden by their mother.

videos.title: Dreamcatcher
videos.overview: When Elena's dreams magically start coming to life, she must confront the underlying feelings causing them.

videos.title: Changing of the Guard
videos.overview: Elena helps the Royal Seamstress follow her dream of becoming the first female member of Avalor's Royal Guard.

videos.title: King Skylar
videos.overview: When Skylar's father falls ill, he becomes king for a day and must learn what it takes to be in charge.

videos.title: Spirit of a Wizard
videos.overview: Mateo and Elena try to free Mateo's grandfather from an enchanted book.

videos.title: Team Isa
videos.overview: When Elena falls under the spell of a magical bandit named Tito, it's up to Isabel and her friends to save Elena and the kingdom.

videos.title: The Last Laugh
videos.overview: Naomi has second thoughts about her role on the Grand Council after her childhood friend, Veronica, visits.

videos.title: Festival of Lights
videos.overview: A royal family from the Latino Jewish kingdom of Galonia is shipwrecked off the coast of Avalor on their way home to celebrate Hanukkah, so Elena invites them to the palace to celebrate their cherished holiday and learn about their traditions.

videos.title: The Birthday Cruise
videos.overview: Elena throws a birthday party for Princess Chloe aboard the royal sailboat, but things go awry when they wash ashore a magical isle inhabited by a cursed sea nymph.

videos.title: Giant Steps
videos.overview: Naomi returns to Avalor to warn Elena about a growing magical threat to the kingdom.

videos.title: Shooting Stars
videos.overview: Elena and Isa learn what it takes to succeed at science when they must fix a telescope in time for their grandfather to see a rare comet.

videos.title: Crash Course
videos.overview: Gabe recruits a flashy wizard, Bronzino, to teach his guards magic, but learns that there are no shortcuts to success.

videos.title: Sweetheart's Day
videos.overview: When Armando tries to impress Marlena on Sweetheart's Day, he accidentally casts a spell that causes everyone in the town to start singing.

videos.title: The Lightning Warrior
videos.overview: Elena needs the help of two old enemies in order to free a new magical ally from a curse.

videos.title: Día de las Madres
videos.overview: After a revelation leaves Luisa doubting her mothering skills, Elena tries to rally her spirits on Mother's Day.

videos.title: Heart of the Jaguar
videos.overview: Quita Moz sees a prophecy about Isabel and sends her on a fantastic quest to find an object that will give her the courage to face anything.

videos.title: Elena's Day Off
videos.overview: With only a few days left until Elena's Coronation, Elena is forced to take a much-needed day off.

videos.title: To Queen or Not to Queen
videos.overview: When Elena wonders what her life would be like if she had not been born a princess, Zuzo casts a spell to show Elena an alternate reality.

videos.title: Coronation Day
videos.overview: On the day of Elena's coronation. Esteban releases Legendary Spirit misfits forcing Elena to journey to the spirit world to save her kingdom.

awards: Nominated for 1 Primetime Emmy. 15 wins & 32 nominations total
